description: This Java class 'DefaultMonitoringLoggerConfig' implements the 'MonitoringLoggerConfig' interface, providing configuration parameters for monitoring logging such as capacities, log size limits, durations, and check intervals. It includes methods to instantiate the configuration from a Typesafe Config object and overrides 'equals', 'hashCode', and 'toString' methods.

classes.name: DefaultMonitoringLoggerConfig
classes.description: Immutable class providing monitoring logger configuration settings such as capacities, log size, durations, and check intervals, initialized from a hierarchical config source.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DefaultMonitoringLoggerConfig from a Typesafe Config object, applying fallback logic.

methods.name: successCapacity
methods.description: Returns the capacity allocated for successful log entries.

methods.name: failureCapacity
methods.description: Returns the capacity allocated for failed log entries.

methods.name: maxLogSizeInBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum log size in bytes.

methods.name: logDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration for log retention or reporting.

methods.name: loggingActiveCheckInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval for checking if logging is active.
